title: Word Break Sentences (SWE Supplement)
prompt:
Implement `word_break_sentences(s, word_dict)`. Insert spaces into the nonempty lowercase string `s` so that every resulting word belongs to `word_dict`. Return every distinct valid sentence, sorted lexicographically. A dictionary word may be reused any number of times. Return `[]` if there is no complete segmentation.

`word_dict` contains nonempty lowercase words. Duplicate entries have no additional effect.

example.reasoning: Both paths cover every character using dictionary words. No other dictionary-word sequence covers the string.
